integrity: All mathematical statements are supported by explicit input-output algebra and an accompanying reproducible symbolic checker; literature comparison is limited by specifically identified inaccessible full texts. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the normalized, nonspatial, autonomous two-parameter Klausmeier ODE with exact biomass observations; no noisy/discrete measurements, variable forcing, spatial PDE or unknown normalizations. The third-jet inversion can be ill-conditioned and is singular at isolated nonstationary instants.
title: Biomass-only identifiability and the sharp third-jet threshold in the nonspatial Klausmeier model
